wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: each site is one identifier lookup whose result is compared for read routes (change record, screenshot sources, add-on detail) and write routes (comments, checks, announcements, labels) alike, and the per-lever patches fail on both

wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: every identifier is an integer URL path segment; a malformed one does not reach a lookup
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: no authority secret, token or external role provider participates in this protection
wrong_fix_catalogue.adjacent_api: n/a: the shared helper is the task's own lever and has its own security test; no other stated API changes with the fix
